issue: दिन दोपारा दूर परैं — दोपारा is midday; दूर परैं has no stated subject. In stanza 2 the same words are said of obstacles (विघ्न भाग जा दूर परैं).
our reading: At midday, obstacles fell far away (the subject taken from stanza 2).
alternatives: A corruption of a time phrase (e.g. दिन दोपहरा पूर परैं, 'when midday was full'); the line then says only 'at midday'.

issue: देख वेद ब्रह्मा जी जाको — देख वेद read as 'having looked into the Veda'; जाको (whom) as the one named. Also इन्द्र अप्सरा: Indra's apsarases or Indra and the apsarases.
our reading: Brahmā looked into the Veda and named him Vighnavināśaka; Indra's apsarases danced.
alternatives: Seeing him, Brahmā (and) the Vedas named him; Indra and the apsarases danced.
